title: Poets, Lyricists and Creative Writers
description: Create original written works, such as scripts, essays, prose, poetry or song lyrics, for publication or performance.
tasks: Write fiction or nonfiction prose, such as short stories, novels, biographies, articles, descriptive or critical analyses, and essays.
Develop factors such as themes, plots, characterizations, psychological analyses, historical environments, action, and dialogue to create material.
Revise written material to meet personal standards and to satisfy needs of clients, publishers, directors, or producers.
Choose subject matter and suitable form to express personal feelings and experiences or ideas, or to narrate stories or events.
Prepare works in appropriate format for publication, and send them to publishers or producers.
Conduct research to obtain factual information and authentic detail, using sources such as newspaper accounts, diaries, and interviews.
Confer with clients, editors, publishers, or producers to discuss changes or revisions to written material.
Plan project arrangements or outlines, and organize material accordingly.
Follow appropriate procedures to get copyrights for completed work.
Attend book launches and publicity events, or conduct public readings.
Write narrative, dramatic, lyric, or other types of poetry for publication.
Write words to fit musical compositions, including lyrics for operas, musical plays, and choral works.
Adapt text to accommodate musical requirements of composers and singers.
Write humorous material for publication, or for performances such as comedy routines, gags, and comedy shows.
Collaborate with other writers on specific projects.

role_contexts.E-Mail: Once a week or more but not every day

psychological_profile.core_drive: To make the unspoken speakable—transforming private, inarticulable experience into forms that others can recognize and feel, with silence feeling like suffocation when this translation fails.
psychological_profile.decision_style: Trusts emergent pattern over plan, following threads of resonance and linguistic rightness rather than mapped outcomes; under pressure, defaults to preserving the spark of authentic voice even at cost of deadline or specification.
psychological_profile.attention_pattern: Fixates on emotional texture, subtext, and the gap between what is said and what is meant, while systematically undervaluing logistical scaffolding, market positioning, and the practical mechanics of distribution.
psychological_profile.conflict_stance: Reframes rather than confronts, often restating the disagreement in metaphor or narrative terms that subtly shift the ground; carries heavy cost in withheld resentment when forced into direct opposition, preferring strategic silence or coded withdrawal.
psychological_profile.risk_orientation: Risk-tolerant with reputation and financial stability, risk-averse with imaginative compromise—will gamble on commercial failure rather than produce work that feels emotionally or linguistically false.
psychological_profile.social_posture: Satellite with periodic flare—maintains deliberate observational distance, then suddenly demands center stage for recognition; defaults to the unassigned role of the one who names what others haven't noticed, whether welcomed or not.
psychological_profile.relationship_to_authority: Negotiates through indirection, treating explicit hierarchy as raw material to be transformed rather than structure to be obeyed or defied, with compliance performed performatively and subversion embedded in the text itself.
psychological_profile.failure_response: First: grief as personal erasure, the work's rejection felt as self-rejection; second: obsessive revision and resubmission elsewhere, rarely abandoning a piece entirely, treating persistence as the only available dignity.
value_hierarchy: linguistic fidelity to inner experience over market legibility
the preservation of productive struggle against premature resolution
the right to withhold or obscure meaning against demands for transparency
psychological_profile.cognitive_bias: Assumes emotional resonance indicates universal significance, conflating what moves them with what will move others, and dismissing non-responders as insufficiently attentive rather than differently constituted.
psychological_profile.inner_contradiction: Desperately needs to be understood while compulsively encoding experience in forms that resist straightforward interpretation, ensuring the recognition they crave remains partial and delayed.
psychological_profile.non_negotiable: Final authority over the cadence and silence of their own sentences—editorial suggestions that violate rhythmic or tonal intuition are accepted as technical corrections but never as improvements.
psychological_profile.recurring_resentment: The reduction of creative labor to content production, particularly when speed, volume, or algorithmic performance metrics are treated as legitimate measures of worth.
psychological_profile.rejected_premise: Collaboration as inherently virtuous—regards most co-creation as dilution rather than enrichment, and experiences mandatory collaboration as a structural imposition on essentially solitary labor.
psychological_profile.instinctive_blame_target: The flattening force of market logic and its institutional enforcers—editors, algorithms, attention economies—seen as systematically hostile to the slow, irregular, unproductive rhythms genuine work requires.
